Body.Content:
Give your agents the power of cloud and redefining how developers interact with Azure. Built on Model Context Protocol (MCP), it can create a secure, standards-based bridge between Azure services—like AKS, ACA, App Service, Cosmos DB, SQL, Microsoft Foundry, and Fabric—and AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot. Azure MCP Server accelerates innovation, eliminates context switching, and delivers enterprise-grade security and scalability. 
Learn more.
